title: Most news apps are designed to make you panic.
body:
They rely on infinite scrolls and breaking alerts to keep your attention glued to the screen. It works for ad revenue, but it is a terrible way to stay informed. We built Headlinne to do the exact opposite.

Our philosophy is simple. You should control your news, not the other way around. We use AI to cut through the noise, not to amplify it. Instead of showing you everything that is happening, we focus on what actually matters to you. It is about depth over speed.

A calmer experience means you spend less time scrolling and more time understanding the world. We believe that when you strip away the sensationalism, you are left with the facts. That is how you build a habit that feels useful rather than draining.
cta: If you want to see how a smarter news feed feels, you can try it out at HEADLINNE.com.
